english_text: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.
english:
All moments have their own beauty when they arrive.
Humans carry a sense of timelessness within them.
Yet the full pattern of existence remains beyond our complete understanding.
spanish:
Todos los momentos tienen su propia belleza cuando llegan.
Los seres humanos llevan dentro de sí una sensación de eternidad.
Sin embargo, el patrón completo de la existencia está más allá de nuestra comprensión total.
portuguese:
Todos os momentos têm sua própria beleza quando chegam.
Os seres humanos carregam dentro de si uma sensação de atemporalidade.
No entanto, o padrão completo da existência permanece além da nossa compreensão total.
french:
Tous les moments ont leur propre beauté lorsqu'ils arrivent.
Les êtres humains portent en eux un sentiment d'éternité.
Cependant, le schéma complet de l'existence dépasse notre compréhension totale.
tagalog:
Ang bawat sandali ay may sariling kagandahan kapag dumarating ito.
Ang mga tao ay may dalang pakiramdam ng kawalang-hanggan sa loob nila.
Gayunpaman, ang buong kaayusan ng pag-iral ay lampas sa ating ganap na pag-unawa.
swahili:
Kila wakati una uzuri wake wenyewe unapofika.
Watu wanabeba hisia ya umilele ndani yao.
Hata hivyo, muundo kamili wa kuwepo uko nje ya uelewa wetu kamili.
mandarin_chinese:
每个时刻在到来时都有其独特的美。
人们心中携带着一种永恒的感受。
然而，存在的完整格局超出我们的全部理解。
russian:
Каждый момент обладает своей красотой, когда наступает.
Люди несут в себе ощущение вечности.
Тем не менее, полная картина бытия остаётся за пределами нашего полного понимания.
malayalam:
ഓരോ നിമിഷവും അതിന്റെ സമയത്ത് സ്വന്തം സൗന്ദര്യം കൈവരിക്കുന്നു.
മനുഷ്യർ അവരുടെ ഹൃദയത്തിൽ ശാശ്വതതയുടെ അനുഭൂതി കൈവരിക്കുന്നു.
എങ്കിലും, സൃഷ്ടിയുടെ മുഴുവൻ രൂപരേഖ നമ്മുടെ പൂർണ്ണ ബോധത്തിന് അതീതമാണ്.
